ITEM 1 | Pale pink, flaky-textured piece with a golden-brown breaded or crumb-crusted exterior, roughly 7 cm long and 3 cm wide, two overlapping pieces forming a mound at the lower left of the plate, moist-looking interior, sits on greens | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark green leafy greens, mostly curly-edged and flat spinach-like leaves with some small arugula-type leaves, matte surface with slight moisture, spread across the left and center of the plate covering roughly 30% of its area, a few bits of brownish crumb scattered among them | 45
ITEM 3 | Bright orange-yellow cubes with slightly caramelized edges and dark green skin patches visible on some sides, roughly 2.5 cm pieces, firm and holding shape, matte with slight sheen, sitting on a bed of dark greens at the upper right of the plate | 60
